newsitem.title: THAILAND: IBC to buy shares in Satellite Service.
newsitem.headline: IBC to buy shares in Satellite Service.

text.p: International Broadcasting Corp Plc (IBC) said on Thursday it would buy at least 75 percent and up to 100 percent of Satellite Service Co Ltd shares at a price of no less than 10 baht per share.

IBC said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the company board decided on Wednesday that the transaction would be calculated by taking the net asset value of Satellite Service as appeared in its financial statements on March 31.
IBC, a cable TV operator, said the total transaction would not exceed 1.76 billion baht ($70.4 million) and Phatra Thanakit Plc would be financial adviser to the deal.
The company said the acquisition would allow it to expand into other service areas such as pay TV and multimedia businesses.
Both IBC and Satellite Service are units of the Shinawatra Group, a Thai telecommunication conglomerate.
IBC closed 0.25 baht higher at 11 baht a share on Wednesday.
